content: AWS Architecture Guide: Production Patterns and Best Practices April 24, 2026 • 154 words • 1 min read • Updated Jun 5, 2026 #AWS #Cloud-Native #DevOps TL;DR: A curated guide to building production AWS infrastructure — covering serverless, containers, event-driven architecture, cost optimization, and multi-account governance. Every pattern here has been shipped to production. Everything I’ve learned building on AWS since 2012, organized by domain.
